tagline: Discover films, keep a diary, write reviews
brief: A movie discovery and review site for film fans. The identity should feel cinematic, warm and confident, and stand apart from the red-dominated entertainment category.
criteria: Success: ownable in a category of reels and clapperboards, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, at home in Sunburst and Midnight.

concepts.name: Widescreen C
concepts.idea: A C whose opening is the exact 2.39:1 CinemaScope widescreen frame.
rationale: Name and format in one shape: the letter is the screen
Two primitives (a disc and a stadium slot), so it holds at 16 px
Sunburst on Midnight is distinct in a red-heavy category

recommendation: Widescreen C, refined: optical centring, an opened-up small-size cut, Inter ExtraBold wordmark.
next_steps: Animate the slot opening as a loading/intro motif
